title: Temperature table
hints: Start with the two conversions. Arithmetic on a named type keeps the type, so `c*9/5 + 32` is a `Celsius`; convert it with `Fahrenheit(...)`. The same goes for `Kelvin(c + 273.15)`.
A width before the verb right-aligns: `%7.1f` prints `  -40.0`. Use `%7s  %10s  %7s\n` for the header and `%7.1f  %10.1f  %7.2f\n` for each row. `strings.Repeat("-", 7)` gives the dashes.

Loop with `for c := Celsius(start); c <= end; c += step { ... }` and count with `rows++` inside the loop, then `fmt.Printf("%d rows\n", rows)`. Run `go test` and compare the diff carefully if a space is off.
